OmaStats 1.4.1 keeps your disk selection saved when the bar reloads its settings.

[Download the complete plugin](https://github.com/crmne/omastats/releases/download/v1.4.1/omastats-v1.4.1.tar.gz), or install it with:

```sh
omarchy plugin add https://github.com/crmne/omastats.git --enable
```

![OmaStats with NVMe 1 selected and the Used readout retained, using synthetic demo data](https://github.com/crmne/omastats/releases/download/v1.4.1/omastats-1.4.1-disk-settings-dark.png)

## Fixed

- **Your chosen disk stays selected.** An older bar settings snapshot could overwrite the saved choice during a later settings edit, bringing back NVMe 0 instead of NVMe 1. OmaStats now restores the saved settings and preserves the disk and its Speed / Used / Both choice when writing another setting. By @crmne.

## Known limitations

- A mirror, raidz or striped ZFS pool counts against its first data drive only. "All disks" is correct, but picking another drive in the pool shows no space for it.
- A vertical bar with many readouts turned on can run into the bar's center section. Turn off readouts you don't need, or use figure-only looks.

## Thanks

Thanks @crmne for reporting the disk selection regression.

Both bundled binaries are rebuilt twice in CI, compared byte-for-byte with the committed executables, and covered by checksums and GitHub build attestations.

**Full changelog**: https://github.com/crmne/omastats/compare/v1.4.0...v1.4.1
